confidence_notes: Food anchors use Boston aggregate prices updated June 5, 2026, near the July pricing window. Cocktail and wine are estimates based on the $8 draft beer price, at about 2x and 1.6x; lodging estimates are broad and especially uncertain during Boston’s summer season.
